say:2:1320338001:1.text: Excuse me, do you know where Levski is?
say:2:1320338001:1.source_cn: 大叔！列夫斯基他……他去哪了？

say:3:1320338002:1.text: Oh, kind souls... thank you for keeping him in your thoughts. But he has... he has already...
say:3:1320338002:1.source_cn: 好心人……谢谢你们还惦记着他。但他已经……已经……

choice_prompt:4:1320338002.text: Oh, kind souls... thank you for keeping him in your thoughts. But he has... he has already...
choice_prompt:4:1320338002.source_cn: 好心人……谢谢你们还惦记着他。但他已经……已经……

say:5:1320338003:1.text: It was a miracle that Levski managed to hold on this long...
say:5:1320338003:1.source_cn: 不，您不用道歉！对我来说，列夫斯基能坚持这么久，已经是...
say:5:1320338003:1.male: It was a miracle that Levski managed to hold on this long...
say:5:1320338003:1.female: It was a miracle that Levski managed to hold on this long...

say:6:1320338004:1.text: And thanks to the good news you shared, he left this world peacefully... with hope in his heart...
say:6:1320338004:1.source_cn: 而且因为您带来的那个好消息，他走的时候很轻松……是带着...

say:6:1320338004:1.female: And thanks to the good news you shared, he left this world peacefully... with hope in his heart...

say:7:1320338005:1.text: He left a <style="highlight">letter</style> for you, right <style="highlight">on the table</style>. He said you would surely come...
say:7:1320338005:1.source_cn: 他还给您留下了<style=highlight>一封信...

say:7:1320338005:1.female: He left a <style="highlight">letter</style> for you, right <style="highlight">on the table</style>. He said you would surely come...

say:8:1320338006:1.text: *Sob* I'm sorry, but I need some time alone...
say:8:1320338006:1.source_cn: 呜……抱歉，让我一个人静一静吧……

choice:4:0:1.text: I'm so deeply sorry for your loss...
